\documentclass[11pt]{article}
\usepackage{amsmath}
\usepackage{graphicx}
\usepackage{multicol}
\begin{document}
\section{Caret boundaries}
A paragraph must remain whole before an equation.

\begin{equation}
\alpha+\beta=\theta
\end{equation}

A paragraph must remain whole after an equation and before a figure.

\begin{figure}[htbp]
\centering
\includegraphics[width=.25\linewidth]{figure_sample.png}
\caption{Boundary fixture}
\label{fig:boundary}
\end{figure}

A paragraph must remain whole after a figure and before columns.

\begin{multicols}{2}
Column one text.
\columnbreak
Column two text.
\end{multicols}

A final paragraph must remain whole after columns.
\end{document}
